head: 9314aa08c41d84672467b06df8d0cf51e5d7ecf2
changes: Incoming Begin/Intent/Attempt durable acknowledgements run outside export.use_lock. Lock acquired only before real stub request; original export/stop state rechecked after acquisition.

After stub acquisition, Resource/Prepared/Connected and periodic sample use an exact owned boxed recording future that captures reporter/actual IDs/metrics only. On stop/invalidation the same future is retained, not replaced by an ACK.

Network ownership ends before actual stub.close; cleanup result marks failed before releasing use_lock; only afterward original pending recording is awaited, then Closing and Finish, preserving phase order.
Export.close likewise releases actual resource lock after helper close before recording. close_all starts every owned close task before joining any result; no abort and independent errors retained.
Native synchronous stop checks recognize closed watch sender even when its last value is false, honoring caller-disappearance contract.

new_tests.name: stopped_recording_keeps_its_ack_but_does_not_hold_cleanup_lock
new_tests.scope: actual production record_or_stop and cleanup_then_unlock helpers driven by oneshot gates; the original recording future is proved polled and retained; lock stays held until modeled cleanup result, failure flag precedes unlock, original rejection and cleanup error remain separate.

new_tests.name: all_close_tasks_start_while_a_sibling_record_ack_is_delayed
new_tests.scope: actual join_closes consumes owned JoinSet tasks; sibling start and failure observable before first recording ACK; no abort or fail-as-success.

new_tests.name: vanished_foreground_stop_sender_skips_the_real_helper
new_tests.scope: actual prepare owner with dropped false-valued sender and guaranteed missing helper socket must return Ok(None).

limitations: Software gates model helper completion. They do not prove real helper, kernel, syscall-active, USB or hardware behavior.
Preparation-stage Native export Resource acknowledgement unbounded delay remains outside this narrow fix, as does arbitrary persistence actor hard blockage. No all-WAL-stall timely-cleanup claim.
True already-sent helper prepare/commit/close futures remain noncancelled and retained until their real results. No relaxation of root proof or generation checks.
review: I independent source-delta review requested; result separate.
